dataSetInformation.sourceCitation: European Commission, DG Environment (2016): Product and Organisation Environmental Footprint - Compliance requirements of PEF and OEF guide 2013, Guidance PEF pilots v. 5.2, Guidance OEF pilots v.4. Secondary data sets for mandatory use.
dataSetInformation.sourceDescriptionOrComment: This data sets is part of the data set packages for which use rights have been purchased by the European Commission for mandatory use until 31/12/2020 when developing PEF or OEF studies under any of the 24 PEFCRs and 2 OEFSRs that have been developed in the PEF/OEF pilot phase. The specific requirements on the data sets are defined in the European Commission's PEF and OEF guides of 2013 and the "Guidance for the implementation of the EU Product Environmental Footprint (PEF) during the Environmental Footprint (EF) pilot phase" v.5.2 as well as the "Guidance for the implementation of the EU Organisation Environmental Footprint (OEF) during the Environmental Footprint (EF) pilot phase" v.4. Other details on the usage of the data sets are defined in the individual PEFCRs and OEFSRs.
